title: fix(openai): skip temperature and top_p for reasoning models on the Responses API

files.patch:
@@ -362,17 +362,23 @@ def encode_request(
         }
     )
     encode_thoughts = False
+    is_reasoning_model = base_model_name not in NON_REASONING_MODELS
 
     with _base_utils.ensure_all_params_accessed(
         params=params,
         provider_id="openai",
-        unsupported_params=["top_k", "seed", "stop_sequences"],
+        unsupported_params=[
+            "top_k",
+            "seed",
+            "stop_sequences",
+            *(["temperature", "top_p"] if is_reasoning_model else []),
+        ],
     ) as param_accessor:
-        if param_accessor.temperature is not None:
+        if not is_reasoning_model and param_accessor.temperature is not None:
             kwargs["temperature"] = param_accessor.temperature
         if param_accessor.max_tokens is not None:
             kwargs["max_output_tokens"] = param_accessor.max_tokens
-        if param_accessor.top_p is not None:
+        if not is_reasoning_model and param_accessor.top_p is not None:
             kwargs["top_p"] = param_accessor.top_p
         if param_accessor.thinking is not None:
             thinking_config = param_accessor.thinking

 import copy
 from typing import Any, cast
 
+import pytest
 from inline_snapshot import snapshot
 from pydantic import BaseModel
 
@@ -309,3 +310,36 @@ class Book(BaseModel):
     assert text["format"]["schema"]["additionalProperties"] is False
     assert "additionalProperties" not in format.schema
     assert format.schema == schema_before
+
+
+def test_reasoning_model_skips_sampling_params(
+    caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture,
+) -> None:
+    """Reasoning models reject temperature/top_p on the Responses API."""
+    with caplog.at_level("WARNING"):
+        _, _, kwargs = encode_request(
+            model_id="openai/o4-mini",
+            messages=[llm.messages.user("Hello")],
+            format=None,
+            tools=Toolkit(None),
+            params={"temperature": 0.7, "top_p": 0.9, "max_tokens": 100},
+        )
+
+    assert "temperature" not in kwargs
+    assert "top_p" not in kwargs
+    assert kwargs.get("max_output_tokens") == 100
+    assert "Skipping unsupported parameter: temperature=0.7" in caplog.text
+    assert "Skipping unsupported parameter: top_p=0.9" in caplog.text
+
+
+def test_non_reasoning_model_keeps_sampling_params() -> None:
+    _, _, kwargs = encode_request(
+        model_id="openai/gpt-4o",
+        messages=[llm.messages.user("Hello")],
+        format=None,
+        tools=Toolkit(None),
+        params={"temperature": 0.7, "top_p": 0.9},
+    )
+
+    assert kwargs.get("temperature") == 0.7
+    assert kwargs.get("top_p") == 0.9
